**What this changes**

**How it was checked**

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (lint, types, tests)
- [ ] `pnpm test:demo` passes, if the demo or the picker changed
- [ ] `pnpm test:package` passes, if what is published changed
- [ ] New data has its source, address and licence in `NOTICE.md`, and was made by a script
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md`, if a user would notice
